HADESANCIENTS-EASY_SHOT.title: Easy Shot
HADESANCIENTS-EASY_SHOT.description: The first 0{energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} card you play from your [gold]Hand[/gold] each turn is played an additional time.
HADESANCIENTS-FULLY_LOADED.title: Fully Loaded
HADESANCIENTS-FULLY_LOADED.description: At the start of each combat, add [blue]{Cards}[/blue] different random Attacks into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. They're free to play this turn.
HADESANCIENTS-HUNTER_DASH.title: Hunter Dash
HADESANCIENTS-HUNTER_INSTINCT.title: Hunter Instinct
HADESANCIENTS-HUNTER_INSTINCT.descriptio: At the start of your turn, add a random 0{energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} card into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It's free to play this turn.
HADESANCIENTS-HUNTERS_MARK.title: Hunter's Mark
HADESANCIENTS-HUNTERS_MARK.description: At the start of each turn, apply [blue]{MarkedPower}[/blue] [gold]Marked[/gold] to a random enemy.
HADESANCIENTS-KILLING_STROKE.title: Killing Stroke
HADESANCIENTS-KILLING_STROKE.description: Upon pickup, add [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [gold]Clean Kill[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
HADESANCIENTS-LETHAL_SNARE.title: Lethal Snare
HADESANCIENTS-LETHAL_SNARE.description: The first time each turn you apply a debuff to an enemy, apply [blue]{WeakPower}[/blue] [gold]Weak[/gold] and [blue]{VulnerablePower}[/blue] [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] to ALL enemies.
HADESANCIENTS-PRESSURE_POINTS.title: Pressure Points
HADESANCIENTS-PRESSURE_POINTS.descriptio: Every [blue]5th[/blue] Attack you play deals [blue]{MoreDamagePercent}%[/blue] more damage.
HADESANCIENTS-SHADOW_POUNCE.title: Shadow Pounce
HADESANCIENTS-SHADOW_POUNCE.description: The first time each turn you play [blue]{Cards}[/blue] Attacks, the next Skill you play from your [gold]Hand[/gold] is free to play.
HADESANCIENTS-SUPPORT_FIRE.title: Support Fire
HADESANCIENTS-SUPPORT_FIRE.description: Whenever you play a card, deal [blue]{Damage:diff()}[/blue] damage to a random enemy.
HADESANCIENTS-VITAL_SIGN.title: Vital Sign
HADESANCIENTS-VITAL_SIGN.description: Your Attacks deal [blue]{MoreDamagePercent}%[/blue] more damage against enemies that have [blue]{HpThreshold}%[/blue] HP or more.
HADESANCIENTS-WHISPERED_PRAYER.title: Whispered Prayer
HADESANCIENTS-WHISPERED_PRAYER.descripti: Whenever you play a Power card, gain [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
